# AgentReady

> AgentReady is a free AI sales-visibility scanner. Enter any website URL and get a 0–100 score of how discoverable and parseable your store is for AI shopping agents (ChatGPT Shopping, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode), plus concrete fixes.

## What we check
- robots.txt access for 7 major AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended)
- llms.txt presence
- schema.org structured data: Product, Offer, Organization, FAQPage (JSON-LD)
- XML sitemap discoverability
- Answer-readiness metadata: title, meta description, Open Graph, canonical

## Key pages
- [Home & scanner](/): run a free scan
- [Pricing & monitoring](/pricing): start free AI-visibility monitoring with email alerts
- [Get Agent-Ready Verified](/get-verified): earn an embeddable, live-verified badge proving your store is visible to AI shopping agents
- [Methodology](/#how): what the score measures
- [FAQ](/#faq): common questions

## Pricing
- Instant scan: free, no signup
- Free monitoring: 1 store, weekly re-scan, email alert on regression
- Pro $19/mo (early access): up to 3 stores, daily re-scans, 90-day history, shareable reports
- Team $49/mo (early access): up to 25 stores, Slack + email alerts, white-label reports, CSV/API

## Machine-payable APIs
- [x402 APIs](https://x402.agiscorecard.com): pay-per-call version of this scan for autonomous agents — $0.005/call in USDC via the x402 protocol, no account or API key

## Audience
E-commerce merchants, DTC brands, and agencies preparing for agentic commerce (ACP, UCP, MCP).
